messages:
sophie (support): FYI incoming customer ticket from Acme — they get a 403 when creating a new API key right after upgrading. UI shows 'Invalid API key'.

matt (support): can you paste the raw request + response?

sophie (support): here —
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \\  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" \\  -H \"X-Tenant: acme\" \\  -d '{\"label\":\"mobile-key\"}'
```
response: 403
```json
{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"reason\":\"subscription_required\",\"message\":\"upgrade required to create keys\"}
```

ajay (eng): that body is from the entitlement service. gateway is translating entitlement-deny into our generic \"Invalid API key\" UI copy. saw a correlation id in logs: cid=acme-0x9f1. entitlement.check returned DENY code=403 reason=subscription_expired.

sophie (support): customer says billing page shows upgrade complete ~10m ago. they did the upgrade from Starter -> Team.

lisa (billing): invoice processed at 2267889750 (~7m ago). account.plan_id = team_2026. But entitlement-cache was on a 10m propagation window; also infra ran a cache-flush job ~5m ago that failed for a few tenants. likely race between billing commit and cache propagation.

ajay (eng): repro steps I ran locally: curl with X-Tenant acme + bearer -> entitlement returns 403 until cache refresh. sample from entitlement logs:
```
[INFO] 2267890100 entitlement.check tenant=acme result=DENY code=403 reason=subscription_expired src=billing-sync
```
ajay (eng): suggested immediate mitigation: (1) surface entitlement.reason in API response (don't map to generic invalid credentials) so we don't mislead customers, (2) add a short-term backfill job to push updated plans to entitlement cache for recently-upgraded tenants, (3) add an alert when billing->entitlement propagation exceeds 2m. I'll open PRs for 1 and 2.

matt (support): workaround for Acme: applied a temporary license-override so the API call succeeds while infra backfills. notified customer.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-8271 — investigate cache propagation failure and add alert (priority: P2).

ajay (eng): opened PR #4582 to change gateway mapping + add structured reason in response body. assigning infra for cache TTL fix.

sophie (support): thanks — I'll update the customer with repro explanation and ETA. marking the support ticket P1 due to customer impact. :thumbsup:
